description: Hand-labelled reference set: the 24 h window ending at window.end from 13 German news feeds (FAZ, Heise, Tagesschau, n-tv, taz, MDR, Golem, Deutschlandfunk, Spiegel, Welt, Stern, Zeit, SZ), keyed by entry URL; no article text. Every listed article is labelled. Same "event": the same concrete news, must be grouped. A shared "topics" entry: same broader topic or a multi-topic item, neutral (neither required nor an error). Any other pair must not be grouped.
